name: Governor Livingston High School
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Home team. Colors are estimates sampled from logos; NJSIAA lists scarlet and navy (via Wikipedia). Logo is the school crest (500x352 transparent PNG) used as the header logo on bhpsnj.org/o/glhs (URL taken from a Wayback Machine copy because the live site blocks scripted fetches). Alternate athletics 'GL with sword' logo saved as assets/logos/governor-livingston-athletics.png (549x492) from https://nj.vsand-static.com/Logos/3251.png?404=missinglogo&maxwidth=1100&maxheight=1100. Mascot name per Wikipedia: Hank the Highlander. Boys and girls fencing pages both exist on nj.com for 2026-27. lat/lng from Nominatim (OpenStreetMap school feature); OSM tags the campus with postcode 07974 but the school's mailing zip is 07922.

name: Morris Knolls High School
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Colors estimated from logo (NJSIAA: green and gold). Logo (400x475) is from nj.com; it is the same 'Home of the Golden Eagles' shield the school uses as its header logo (official copy is only 171x203: https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1739358972/mhrdorg/ytblqinjjlkehwsbt1jq/MorrisKnollsHighSchoolPrimaryLogoImage.png). Mailing address is Rockaway; campus is in Denville Township. Both boys and girls fencing listed on GL's 2026-27 boys and girls schedules at highschoolsports.nj.com. lat/lng from Nominatim (OpenStreetMap school feature).

name: Montclair High School

name: St. Benedict's Preparatory School
address: 520 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Colors estimated from logo (NJSIAA: garnet and gray; Wikipedia uses #632434 for garnet). Logo (569x568 Gray Bee mascot) is from nj.com, not the school's own site; sbp.org only exposed a 100px seal and a white-text wordmark. sbp.org lists both Boys Varsity Fencing and Girls Varsity Fencing teams. name: Morris Catholic High School
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Colors estimated from logo (NJSIAA: navy blue and white; the logo blue is closer to royal). Logo (400x400 interlocking MC) is from nj.com, not the school's own site (school header only has an 'every student matters' campaign badge). nj.com lists the fencing program as a co-op, 'Morris Catholic/Pope John', with both boys and girls pages for 2026-27; the school's fencing page mentions girls fencing results and a three-weapon program. NOT on GL's nj.com 2026-27 boys or girls schedule as of 2026-11-09. lat/lng from Nominatim (OpenStreetMap school feature) (school feature on Morris Avenue; no house number in OSM).

name: West Morris Mendham High School
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Colors estimated from logo; NJSIAA order is red, white and navy blue, but the logo is predominantly navy so navy is given as primary. Logo (400x362 minuteman) is from nj.com; the school's own header crest is only 124x210 (https://cmsv2-assets.apptegy.net/uploads/15986/logo/18553/Mendham-Logo.png). Boys and girls fencing pages both exist on nj.com for 2026-27 (listed as 'Mendham'); Wikipedia also describes both teams. NOT on GL's nj.com 2026-27 boys or girls schedule as of 2026-11-09. Do not confuse with West Morris Central ('West Morris' on nj.com). Geocoding the street address in Nominatim returns a wrong match in Brookside, so the coordinates come from the named OSM school feature (matches Wikipedia's 40.7777, -74.5913).

name: Dr. Ronald E. McNair Academic High School
notes: Address, zip, nickname and NJSIAA colors per Wikipedia infobox. Hex colors are estimates. Colors estimated from logo (gold with dark brown outline); NJSIAA lists brown and yellow. Logo (600x539 'McNair M Athletics') is from nj.com; the school site has no logo image. The word 'Athletics' in the logo is white script and will not show on a white background. Both boys and girls fencing listed on GL's 2026-27 boys and girls schedules at highschoolsports.nj.com. An NJSIAA posting also has McNair seeking boys and girls fencing bouts. lat/lng from Nominatim (OpenStreetMap school feature).
